messages:
Jordan: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem on the GenServe outage — putting up a short owner matrix. Reply with owner + Jira ticket + ETA and I'll consolidate.

Jordan: Action items (draft):
1) KV cache eviction edge case (cold start spike) — suggested owner @Maria
2) Canary for model fallback + rollback gates — suggested owner @Lee
3) Runbook + oncall playbook update (postmortem steps) — suggested owner @Nina
4) Prefix routing alerts + dashboards — suggested owner @Raj

Maria: I can take #1. Created JIRA-5243 with repro and logs. ETA: EOW (Fri).
Lee: I'll own #2. JIRA-5250 created. Planning canary this week, target ETA Wed.
Nina: I'll do #3. JIRA-5251. Need two days to update runbooks and run a quick playbook walkthrough. ETA Thu.
Raj: I'll pick up #4. JIRA-5252. Will add alert thresholds + dashboards, ETA Mon next week.

Jordan: Thanks — @Maria can you add the short repro steps and the critical log snippets into JIRA-5243? Helps SRE and QA.
Maria: Done, added repro steps + sample logs and a link to the trace id.
Lee: For the canary rollout I propose RACI: R=Lee, A=Jordan, C=Eng-SRE, I=Product. Sounds good?
Jordan: Agree. @Eng-SRE please confirm capacity window for the canary.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check 1799994700 (one week).
Nina: Also propose a handoff: once runbook is updated I'll pair with Raj so alerts reflect the new mitigation steps.
Raj: Works for me — will tune thresholds after Nina's changes land.
Jordan: I'll link all JIRAs to the postmortem doc and convert them into remediation board cards by EOD unless someone objects.
Maria: :thumbsup:
Lee: :rocket:
Nina: Thanks — I'll ping when the first draft runbook PR is up.

Jordan: Summarized owner matrix (for the postmortem doc):
- KV eviction: owner=Maria, jira=JIRA-5243, eta=Fri, RACI=R:Maria, A:Jordan, C:Eng-ML, I:All
- Canary fallback: owner=Lee, jira=JIRA-5250, eta=Wed, RACI=R:Lee, A:Jordan, C:Eng-SRE, I:Product
- Runbooks: owner=Nina, jira=JIRA-5251, eta=Thu, RACI=R:Nina, A:Jordan, C:Oncall, I:All
- Alerts/dashboards: owner=Raj, jira=JIRA-5252, eta=Mon, RACI=R:Raj, A:Jordan, C:Observability, I:Eng

Jordan: If no objections I'll update the doc and hand these off to the remediation board. Plan to close looping by next checkpoint.
Raj: No objections, go ahead.
Maria: Good plan.
Lee: LGTM.
Nina: All clear from me.

Jordan: Thanks everyone — closing this thread and moving items into the remediation tracker. If anything slips, reopen here or ping me directly.
